method: Read original Blender 2.73 SDNA Material/MTex/Tex/Image blocks; all decoded struct byte sizes match stored SDNA lengths.
decision: These packed images were active diffuse-color multiply layers, not ambient-only occlusion bindings. The verified sRGB images are now decoded to linear light and composited into separate runtime base-color textures, using med colfac .5 and cloth1, modulated by layer alpha. Preserve occlusionPath as unbound metadata; do not relabel aoPath/aoStrength/aoTexCoord.
changesThisAudit: Original diffuse/normal images remain unchanged. Separate derived base-color PNGs reproduce color multiplication; recipe and input/output hashes are in derived/legacy-color-recipe.json. No geometry, motion or catalogue edits.
